objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Included in the document name by default when new document objects are attached.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number for each type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Included in the document name after abbreviation and number.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document using integrated TAG technology.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document using integrated TAG technology.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document using integrated TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via a user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign a personal authorization and workflow participant.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign personal authorization and review workflow participant.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign personal authorization and release workflow participant.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the period of extended validity is calculated.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used with Valid From to calculate Valid Until.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration defined for each document type after which archived documents are physically deleted.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Differentiates documents for structuring and evaluation; selected when creating new documents.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in document names.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period defined for each document type for validity checks.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive duration defined for each document type.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template that can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or documents can be generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File that can be uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the release of the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: version
objs.description: Version of a document created by revision or changes and documented with release signatures.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned to user groups or persons for each document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person involved in document reading, authoring, reviewing, releasing, translating, acknowledgement or requests.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for reader assignment, authorizations, distribution and archive access.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System role implemented to provide users with functions according to area of application.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document without affecting the content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a released document that has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and completed during release, acknowledgement and request workflows.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document with user groups or persons informed about release or requested to acknowledge.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from persons and user group users assigned for acknowledgement.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users about workflow tasks, released versions, change proposals or validity extension.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific display filled by distribution groups and showing documents relevant to users.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report and search for documents in the system.

objs.name: translation
objs.description: Language-dependent version of released document content checked and released with workflow support.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system for which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Entity with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Entity with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Entity with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Entity with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of Master data with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Reference to an original document created from a local addition document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: New documents are created in the system by attachment of a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: A corresponding document type is selected when attaching a new information object.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: One or more document templates can be selected when creating new objects.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: A pure object cover can be created.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: New documents can be generated based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_property
evts.description: Properties editing opens after attachment of an object and standardized or customer-specific metadata can be maintained.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Metadata is maintained automatically or by the user in categories.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Document content is edited with the implemented editing client.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Once the document has been saved, conversion to PDF occurs.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The saved document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: The current version is displayed on the web as a PDF.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group and person-related authorizations are assigned in the Control (release) category.

evts.name: assign_release_participant
evts.description: Participants in the release process are assigned via property editing.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information can be added to each document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information can be deleted again directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Attachments can be added to each document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modification of Attachments triggers a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: mark_attachment_for_archiving
evts.description: Released Attachments are marked for archiving.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Attachments are archived with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: initiate_approval_process
evts.description: After document creation, attribute and content maintenance and definition of document control, the approval process can be initiated.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: In the Creator workflow step, the registered author signs the creation of the document.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser completes the release task positively to finally release the document.

evts.name: reject_review
evts.description: A rejection during review cancels the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: reject_release
evts.description: A rejection during release cancels the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: A new version is created for revised released documents and for changes that trigger a new document version.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: A valid and released document is revised, creating a new version in editing status.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Employees with author rights can create Change proposals for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal_for_implementation
evts.description: If a Change proposal is scheduled for implementation, a new document version is created.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completed Change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: A request for validity extension is created by the system 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The request for validity extension is processed with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Additional validity is declared, deleting the request and keeping the document valid in its current version.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The request for validity extension is deleted when additional validity is declared or a new revised version is released.

evts.name: update_valid_until
evts.description: The Valid until date is updated by the default value of 3 years.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: The validity extension process is automatically terminated when the revised document version is released or when suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Users with write access can create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: After attachment of the request for AKS, the workflow for processing the request is started automatically.

evts.name: check_request_for_aks
evts.description: The Creator, reviewers or releasers check the request and document depending on the AKS process.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: After the declaration of Out of force, the last valid and approved version of the document receives the status Out of force.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Invalidated documents and their attachments are archived.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: All rights except archive group rights are revoked for archived documents.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Existing edited versions are deleted after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Documents are physically deleted after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created in the folder provided for this purpose and the corresponding document is selected.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for reactivation is started automatically.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Once reactivation is confirmed, a new version of the document is created.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Attachments archived with the document are reactivated.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Distribution lists can be maintained for each document by assigning user groups or persons.

evts.name: inform_by_e_mail
evts.description: Assigned users and users of assigned user groups are informed by e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Persons and users of assigned user groups are automatically requested by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Each recipient confirms acknowledgement in a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates released content into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: The translated version is checked with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version is released with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: For each document in a multi-client system, it can be specified in which clients the document is visible.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: A reference to the original document is created for a local addition document.

Documents can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents can be automatically linked with Master data.
IT applications are given as an example of Master data.
A local addition document creates a reference to the original document.
